svg.text: Transformer VQ-VAE tokenizer for protein–ligand complexes
Every pocket and ligand heavy atom is described in one shared frame, encoded jointly, quantized against a shared codebook, and reconstructed by a multi-head decoder.
canonical frame: PCA of pocket Cα,
r, θ, sin φ, cos φ — pocket-frame spherical
· one book shared by both atom sources
r, θ, sin φ, cos φ
+ clash hinge on ligand atom pairs
Atom geometry in the shared pocket frame
· each atom: (r, θ, φ) from the pocket centroid,
· protein and ligand share that frame, so the pose
is encoded per atom — no extra pose tokens
· local shape: spherical offsets to the K = 4
L = Lcoord + Σh LCE(h) + λ Lclash + β Lcommit
· L_coord — Cartesian MSE after denormalizing (r, θ, sin φ, cos φ) → xyz
· L_CE — one term per categorical head; aa / bb-sc masked to protein atoms
· L_clash — hinge on reconstructed ligand atom pairs closer than 1.2 Å
· L_commit — ‖z − sg[e_k]‖²; the codebook itself is updated by EMA, not by gradients
Discrete token sequence — one codebook index per heavy atom
8192 shared codes + 7 special tokens. The same sequence is what the autoregressive generator and the complex MLM rescorer consume.
Ablation variant: separate protein / ligand books (8192 + 8192 or 4096 + 4096), with a learned source embedding added to e_k before the decoder.
